readme.summary: Aphrody is the product repository: application workflows, integration and delivery. Runtime and SDK capabilities belong to [Bun](https://github.com/oven-sh/bun); Material owns the shared M3 framework and UI packages. Google, M3, Obscura and Tauri framework sources live outside Aphrody. Remaining local sources are tracked migration work, not the target ownership (owner directive 2026-10-13).

sections.title: What Aphrody is
body: Aphrody runs in user space: on Linux and Windows on top of the host kernel, in a browser as WebAssembly. It does not ship a kernel of its own. Its layers and their sources:
| Layer | Source | Role |
| Runtime | [oven-sh/bun](https://github.com/oven-sh/bun) | Upstream Bun canary: runs the JavaScript and TypeScript parts |

| Kernel | `crates/os/kernel`, `crates/os/ostd` | Privileged user-space control plane: administration, MCP tools, skills and bus events over local IPC; process supervision, guardrails, secrets, jobs |
| Desktop | `crates/ui/app`, `crates/ui/drive` | Tauri 3 GUI and window manager; file explorer |
| Shell | `crates/shell` | Terminal engine, PTY sessions, embedded Nushell, WebAssembly shell |
| Packages | `crates/pkg` | Content-addressed package store; parsers for winget, apk, deb and pacman sources |
| Command line | `crates/infra/aphrody` | The `aphrody` multi-call binary, which also carries the MCP server `aphrody-mcp` |
| UI framework | Material packages | External M3 framework, components and app-ui; product consumers use package interfaces |
| Web | Bun capabilities | External Obscura engine, crawler and extraction; Aphrody keeps product integration |
| AI backend | `crates/ai` | Private server and automation backend shared by the CLI and authenticated application; never a public product |
Python application code lives in `py/`; native Python hosting (PyO3, CPython, uv, Ruff) and the Python runtime `vu` belong to the runtime.

sections.title: Versions and release cycle
body: - A distribution release is an immutable snapshot on [downloads.aphrody.com](https://downloads.aphrody.com), named `<UTC timestamp>-<commit>` after the monorepo commit it was built from. `latest.json` names the current release and lists every artifact with its version, size and SHA-256; `/releases/<id>/` serves a given release, and the host keeps the last five.
- Each artifact keeps its own version: the Cargo workspace version for `aphrody`, the package version for the others.
- Releases follow no calendar: `scripts/release/publish-downloads.ts` cuts one after the build factory has built a pushed revision.
- Packages under the `@aphrody` npm scope are published one by one, each with its own version.

sections.title: Documentation
body: - Runtime: [aphrody.com/docs](https://aphrody.com/docs), built from the upstream Bun `docs/`; [llms.txt](https://aphrody.com/llms.txt) indexes every page.
- Components and versions: [aphrody.com/components](https://aphrody.com/components), generated from the monorepo, the runtime and the aphrody-labs organization at each site build.
- Distribution internals: `docs/` of the monorepo (index in `docs/README.md`), private with it.

sections.title: Community and governance
body: - Aphrody is developed in the [aphrody-labs](https://github.com/aphrody-labs) GitHub organization, owned by the `aphrody-dev` account, which decides what is published. Owner directives are recorded with their date in `AGENTS.md`.

- Contribution rules: [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md). First-party code is Apache-2.0 (some crates `Apache-2.0 OR MIT`); forks and upstream inputs keep their authors' licences, listed in `THIRD-PARTY.md` and `tools/config/upstream-sources.json`.

sections.title: Security
body: Report vulnerabilities privately through [GitHub private vulnerability reporting on oven-sh/bun](https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/security/advisories/new). Supported versions and artifact verification: [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md).

installation: Depuis ce clone privé, avec Codex installé et authentifié, lance une seule commande :

L’agent installe les produits publiés, les dépendances du poste, les plugins Aphrody/Yolo et le MCP canonique ; il configure Docker, les secrets montés et WASM, puis vérifie chaque composant. Les builds sélectionnent un hôte qualifié selon le contexte et ses ressources. Avec un autre agent CLI, donne-lui directement [cette tâche d’installation](docs/operations/INSTALL-AGENT.md).
Le dépôt et GHCR sont privés : les accès GitHub et fournisseur IA doivent déjà être authentifiés. Les composants absents pour une cible restent signalés dans le résultat d’installation.
| CLI, runtime et plugins | [Téléchargements et installateurs](https://downloads.aphrody.com/) : release immuable et SHA-256 |
| API/MCP Docker et Alpine AMD64/ARM64 | [Runbook Docker](docs/operations/container/CONTAINER.md) : images GHCR privées et digests qualifiés |
| Navigateur/WASM | [Paquet CLI WASM](packages/infra/cli-wasm/README.md) : ESM et module WASM unique |

Les installateurs Windows ont été exécutés sous Wine ; l’application desktop complète, macOS et le SDK FFI intégré demandent encore une qualification sur leurs cibles. Les résultats et limites sont consignés dans les runbooks et [MEMORY.md](MEMORY.md).
74 paquets publiés et vérifiés sur npm, avec versions épinglées et contrôle npm avant installation. Depuis ce clone, dans un projet ayant son `package.json` :

Le [catalogue complet et les limites de qualification](docs/operations/bun-packages.md) couvre les 92 paquets distribuables. `--list` affiche les versions ; `--only @aphrody/qr,@aphrody/fuzzy` sélectionne des paquets. Les 18 paquets nécessitant encore des gates natifs ou d’intégration restent exclus de cette commande.

contracts: Versioned SDK and C ABI: opaque handles, sized structs, ABI/capability negotiation, length-carrying buffers, allocator-side release, explicit errors, cancellation, threading and lifetime rules.
Internal Rust types and engine rlibs are not the application ABI; a standard extension builds without rebuilding engines.
Every context, operation and resource has an owner. Bounded queues, explicit saturation; stop and join workers before unload; respect UI and JS-object threads.
Permissions, origin and isolation are enforced natively. Remote pages get no implicit Bun/host privilege; cookies and profiles stay isolated.
Preserve unwind/recovery at real artifact boundaries; isolate work that can fault memory.
Bun keeps JSC/WebKit, Obscura supplies V8/headless; V8 stays until Obscura/JSC parity. Qualify DOM, GC, exceptions, promises, microtasks, modules, workers, timers, interrupts and teardown.
Keep API/CLI/permission identities, licences, provenance, features and lockfiles. Remove a replaced path in the batch that qualifies its replacement.
Engines build per version/target; refuse an incompatible ABI before any native call.
npm `@aphrody` is the only package channel outside the monorepo; `workspace:*` inside it.
Select development/build context independently from product capability. Current execution and administrator scope: [execution context](docs/operations/workspace/windows-native.md).

Aphrody AI is a private server/backend and automation service, never a public product. CLI and authenticated site sessions consume the same capability owners and versioned backend contracts; complete parity includes models, inference, voice, OCR, translation, memory, RAG, training, agents, Document AI, gateway and status when qualified on the execution target. Preserve authorization, streaming, cancellation, errors, session continuity and isolated provider stores. A prompt-only Cloudflare endpoint does not qualify full parity.

sections.title: Monorepo consolidation

Target kernel architecture recorded from `aphrody git ingest` of Asterinas and the GitHub tree of Linux: `docs/plans/os-kernel/PLAN.md`.
